name: closing-call-to-action-newsletter
purpose: The closing band whose ask is a newsletter sign-up: the overline and a large headline on the lead side, a subscribe form labelled by the ask on the other, over a strip lit by the pixelated primary wave, then the hatched closing frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action-newsletter', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `overline`, `field`, `input`, `button` and `texture-material`. The block never sends: it validates the address locally (an empty field and a malformed address each show their message under the field) and on a valid submit emits `submit` with the event and `{ email }`; the site posts the address and reports the outcome back through `loading`, `submitted` and `error`, which the band renders with the messages from `form`.
useWhen: To close the Blog or the Resource Hub on a newsletter subscription.
avoidWhen: For a close on one or two link actions → use `closing-call-to-action`.
For a lead form with several fields → use `hero-form`.
related: closing-call-to-action` — the closing band whose ask is a link action.
alert` — renders the success and failure messages.
bestPractices: Set `loading` while the address is sent, then `submitted` or `error` with the outcome.
Keep `description` to one sentence; it is set as the large headline.
Write `form.invalidMessage` with an example address so the fix is obvious.

props.name: form
props.doc: Copy of the subscribe form: `{ placeholder, submitLabel, successMessage, errorMessage, requiredMessage, invalidMessage }`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Overline on the lead side, closed by the blinking cursor.

props.name: title
props.doc: The ask, rendered as the label of the email field; it also names the band.

props.name: description
props.doc: The pitch, rendered as the band's large `h2` on the lead side.

props.name: loading
props.doc: The site is sending the address: the field is disabled, the button shows its loading state and a submit is ignored.

props.name: submitted
props.doc: The site sent the address: the form gives way to `form.successMessage`.

props.name: error
props.doc: The site could not send the address: `form.errorMessage` shows under the form.

events.name: submit
events.notes: Fired on a valid submit, not while `loading`; `values` is `{ email }` with the trimmed address. The block never sends it.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToActionNewsletter from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action-newsletter'

  const form = {
    placeholder: 'Your email',
    submitLabel: 'Subscribe',
    successMessage: 'Thanks for subscribing to the Azion newsletter',
    errorMessage: 'We could not subscribe you. Try again.',
    requiredMessage: 'Enter your email address.',
    invalidMessage: 'Enter an email address like name@example.com.'
  }

  const onSubmit = (event, values) => {
    console.log(event.type, values)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <ClosingCallToActionNewsletter
    anchor="contact"
    eyebrow="Stay up to date"
    title="Subscribe to our newsletter"
    description="Product updates, event highlights, and industry insights, delivered to your inbox."
    :form="form"
    @submit="onSubmit"
  />
</template>
